evidence_span.text: Later involvement of this enzyme in postsqualene cholesterol biosynthesis was postulated (conversion of zymosterone to zymosterol) and could be proven in vitro.

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: the in vitro finding supports HSD17B7's postsqualene cholesterol-biosynthesis function. The unspecified in vitro system is indirect to aging or MASLD mouse hepatocytes, so the declared partial context is overclaimed.

evidence_span.text: In this work, we investigated the transcriptional regulation of human ERG28, revealing it is an SREBP-2 target, akin to the bulk of cholesterol synthesis enzymes (13).

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: promoter and perturbation experiments support ERG28 as an SREBP-2-regulated cholesterol-homeostasis component. Human liver-derived cancer cells are partially transferable to mouse hepatocytes but do not model aging or MASLD directly.

evidence_span.text: Compared to wild-type siblings, total cholesterol levels of lssnu60 homozygous mutants were 43% (s.d. 9.14, P=0.0011) of wild-type levels, whereas those of msmo1nu81 homozygous mutants were 22% (s.d. 10.59, P=0.0006) of wild-type levels.

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: genetic loss reduced cholesterol for both genes, while liver-specific rescue demonstrated functional hepatic activity. The zebrafish setting is indirect to mouse hepatocytes, matching the declared context.

evidence_span.text: As expected, FDFT1 inhibition decreased the cholesterol content in HCC cells (Figure 6A,B).

reviews.rationale: Model-assessed: genetic and pharmacological inhibition causally supports FDFT1's role in cellular cholesterol production. Liver-derived HCC systems preserve hepatic relevance but differ from aging and MASLD, making context partial.
